description: City introduces 2025 budget, outlining proposed adjustments.
Proposed adjustments lead to 5.2% property tax.
Funds police, roads, transit, and fire services.

chips.text: Councillor Davies noted this budget process reduced the tax requirement before deliberations.
Saskatoon's population grew by 46,000 residents since 2018, projected to 2025.

description: Presents 2025 preliminary budget with 5.2% tax increase.

chips.text: Received as information
11 for, 0 against
Council discussed starting 2025 budget deliberations at 5.2% instead of 5.84%.
Council may further reduce the preliminary tax increase during deliberations.

description: Saskatoon Public Library levy increases 2.8% for 2025.
Police Service adds 24 new frontline officers.
TCU Place, Remai Modern budgets approved without new city funding.

chips.text: Approved
11 for, 0 against
Mayor Block stated policing alone won't solve social issues; housing is key.
Average library patron saves $210 annually through free services.
Provincial funding allows 'once-in-a-generation' acceleration of police hiring.
Police wage arbitration impact on budget remains unknown.
Remai Modern programs help patients feel accepted, unleash creativity, and escape battles.
Police budget faces significant shortfall from pending binding arbitration award.
Remai Modern offers low-sensory events for children on the autism spectrum.
SaskTel Centre will repair unpaved parking lots with recycled asphalt.
Police Service will create a dedicated warrant enforcement team.

description: Committee recommends renewing Nutrien Wonderhub lease with phased-in cost increases.
Wonderhub faces $400,000 deficit; seeks rent relief.
City provides $250,000 annual in-kind rent contribution.

chips.text: Recommended
Councillor Fork noted some Wonderhub exhibits are in disarray and staff engagement is low.
Nutrien Wonderhub, a children's museum, faces a $400,000 deficit for 2024-25.
Nutrien Wonderhub requested Option 4, including rent relief and no new building charges.
Wonderhub cited ambiguous lease wording, potentially contravening new building repair charges.
Wonderhub is implementing a government relations strategy to secure provincial operating grants.
